# dreyv — API context (scoped llms.txt)

> Scoped agent context for the dreyv REST + MCP API surface.
> Same capability registry powers both transports. For full product context see `/llms-full.txt`.

## Canonical specs (read these before generating client code)

- OpenAPI 3.1: https://dreyv.com/openapi.json
- MCP discovery: https://dreyv.com/.well-known/mcp.json
- MCP tool manifest (every tool, every input schema): https://dreyv.com/api/mcp/manifest
- Plugin manifest: https://dreyv.com/.well-known/ai-plugin.json
- ACP descriptor: https://dreyv.com/.well-known/acp.json
- UCP profile: https://dreyv.com/.well-known/ucp
- API catalog (RFC 9727): https://dreyv.com/.well-known/api-catalog
- x402 capability: https://dreyv.com/.well-known/x402
- Developer portal: https://dreyv.com/developers
- MCP setup: https://dreyv.com/developers/mcp
- REST reference: https://dreyv.com/developers/api

## Auth

- Bearer JWT (SIWS) — issued via `/api/auth/*`
- API keys (prefix `dk_live_`) — minted at `/app/settings/api`, scoped per-org
- OAuth 2.0 (beta) — see `/developers#oauth`
- Header (both REST and MCP): `Authorization: Bearer <key>`

## Transports

- REST: `https://dreyv.com/api/v1/{capability_path}` — capability id `foo.bar` → path `/api/v1/foo/bar`
- MCP: `https://dreyv.com/api/mcp` — JSON-RPC over Streamable HTTP, tool name `dreyv_foo_bar`
- Legacy `/api/*` routes (planner, simulate, command, swap, vault, squads, yield, research) remain available

### MCP required headers (per spec)

```
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json, text/event-stream
Authorization: Bearer <key>
```

Servers built with the official MCP SDK reject POSTs without `Accept: application/json, text/event-stream`
with HTTP 406. Always include both media types.

## Public endpoints (no auth)

- `GET /api/health`
- `GET /api/price?token=SOL`
- `GET /api/atlas/tokens`
- `GET /api/atlas/tokens/{symbol}`
- `GET /api/mcp/manifest` — public MCP tool catalog
- `GET /.well-known/mcp.json` — MCP discovery
- `POST /api/mcp` — `initialize` only; `tools/call` requires Bearer

## Authenticated endpoint families

### Capability registry (REST + MCP, unified)

- `/api/v1/identity/*` — wallet resolve, wallet meta, profile
- `/api/v1/portfolio/*` — holdings, PnL, DeFi positions
- `/api/v1/treasury/*` — health, multisig pending
- `/api/v1/market/*` — price, OHLCV, forensics, yields, trending, history
- `/api/v1/swap/*` — Solana/EVM quote + build (unsigned)
- `/api/v1/bridge/*` — bridge quotes
- `/api/v1/gas/*` — gas estimates
- `/api/v1/risk/*` — wallet risk, edge insights
- `/api/v1/wallet/*` — narrative
- `/api/v1/tax/*` — analyze
- `/api/v1/foresight/*` — simulate
- `/api/v1/agentic/*` — delegation request/status
- `/api/v1/watchers/*`, `/api/v1/monitors/*` — agentic monitors
- `/api/v1/economy/*` — x402 catalog, ACP catalog, SKUs
- `/api/v1/governance/*` — proposals, votes
- `/api/v1/defi/*` — positions, yields, vaults
- `/api/v1/knowledge/*` — memory + vector
- `/api/v1/safety/*`, `/api/v1/compliance/*` — sanctions, policy
- `/api/v1/notifications/*`, `/api/v1/inbox/*`, `/api/v1/digests/*`, `/api/v1/webhooks/*`
- `/api/v1/audit/*`, `/api/v1/observability/*`
- `/api/v1/billing/*`, `/api/v1/entitlements/*`
- `/api/v1/teams/*`, `/api/v1/privacy/*`, `/api/v1/storage/*`, `/api/v1/search/*`
- `/api/v1/status/*`, `/api/v1/jobs/*`, `/api/v1/exports/*`
- `/api/v1/tags/*`, `/api/v1/flags/*`, `/api/v1/insights/*`
- `/api/v1/marketplace/*`, `/api/v1/sla/*`, `/api/v1/contracts/*`
- `/api/v1/workflows/*`

Full enumerated list with input schemas, scopes, side-effects (read/simulate/write), status (stable/preview),
and per-call cost: fetch https://dreyv.com/api/mcp/manifest or https://dreyv.com/openapi.json.

### Legacy / convenience routes

- `/api/command/*` — natural-language treasury intents
- `/api/planner/*` — structured intent → plan
- `/api/simulate/*` and `/api/foresight/*` — fork simulation
- `/api/swap/*` — Jupiter quotes/execute (non-custodial)
- `/api/vault/*` — multisig balances and history
- `/api/squads/*` — proposal creation
- `/api/yield/*` and `/api/yields/*` — yield routing
- `/api/research/*`, `/api/tools/crawl`, `/api/tools/browser` — agent research
- `/api/dreyv-gateway/*` — provider-routed AI gateway

## Conventions

- All bodies JSON; UTF-8.
- All responses include `Link` headers (RFC 8288) pointing to api-catalog and service-desc.
- Errors follow RFC 9457 Problem Details when possible.
- Non-custodial: signing happens client-side; server returns sign-ready transactions.
- Scopes are enforced per capability — minted keys can be scoped read-only.
- Per-call cost is exposed in capability metadata; usage is metered against billing tier.
